changeSet.author: devin
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO jhi_user_authority (user_id, authority_name) SELECT u.id, 'ROLE_ADMIN' FROM jhi_user u WHERE u.role = 'RESPONSABLE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jhi_user_authority ua WHERE ua.user_id = u.id AND ua.authority_name = 'ROLE_ADMIN' );

INSERT INTO jhi_user_authority (user_id, authority_name) SELECT u.id, 'ROLE_RESPONSABLE' FROM jhi_user u WHERE u.role = 'RESPONSABLE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jhi_user_authority ua WHERE ua.user_id = u.id AND ua.authority_name = 'ROLE_RESPONSABLE' );

INSERT INTO jhi_user_authority (user_id, authority_name) SELECT u.id, 'ROLE_USER' FROM jhi_user u WHERE u.role = 'RESPONSABLE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jhi_user_authority ua WHERE ua.user_id = u.id AND ua.authority_name = 'ROLE_USER' );
